---
title: "Env.Erase"
description: "Remove the entry for a key from the Env store."
---

Removes any value associated with `key`, regardless of kind. No-op if the key is absent.

## Signature

```enforce
static proto native void Erase(string key);
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| key | `string` | The key to remove. |

## Behavior

The store is locked. After `Erase`, [Env.Has](./has) on the same key returns `0`. Use aggressively when keys are no longer needed — the pool is capped at 256 entries, and writes past the cap are silent no-ops.

## Edge cases

- No-op if `key` is absent. There is no return value to indicate whether anything was removed.
- Does not reset kind state for the key (there is no per-key kind state stored on `Erase` — the slot is fully reclaimed).

## Example

```enforce
Env.SetInt("counter", 42);
Env.Erase("counter");
Env.Has("counter"); // 0
```
